install: set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi; .venv/bin/pip install --no-input -r requirements.txt; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; touch ~/.bashrc; LINE=$(printf 'export PATH="%s/.venv/bin:$PATH"' "$PWD"); grep -qxF "$LINE" ~/.bashrc || echo "$LINE" >> ~/.bashrc
